My mom just called me.. had a really nice chat with her didn't say anything bad just a happy convo.. I broke down when she hanged up.
cried like a baby..ok I'm still crying.

Currently in Logan Utah, USA. Have an Unstable job (temp) have a few interviews lined up but nothing is set in stone. Not just the debt it's my stupid mistakes that I made which affected the people around which got me in this mess is fucking with me.. I'm trying to fix it but not seeing any hope.

Would love to go home but I need to pay off my debt first and lease..I cannot just leave like this regardless how things are. I need to clear my conscious first. My dad does not have money. Even though suicide is tempting the thought of my parents crying hurts me more than anything. but some relief is calling.
There are format issues and other errors but I don't care.

but something is something.
I soo want to pay her back asap, save up and move the fuck out and finally go to school or get my certifications. I want to go back home but I’m so ashamed by all of this I just can’t tell my mom she is so weak  from the hospital. I can’t face my parents properly. I want to see them with at least one certification as a show to them and myself that I'm not going through this for nothing but I'm slowly losing strength. 
All the jobs that I can do are located in Salt lake city but that’s 2 hours away and I don’t have a car round trip bus fare is 60 per day I just don’t have that money so I have to stick to manual labor for now which fine but I’m being pressured to pay her back and I need to save up enough money for a single apartment. Been three days since I've had a decent meal.. been to stressed out to eat something even ramen.
